notes.title: Friday Update #3
notes.content:
This update was a long time coming, finally implemented the ability to customize note colors!

In other news, I recently received a promotion at my full time job giving my more responsibility. This will definitely effect my ability to work on games for a while. I'll keep you updated on future plans and dates as I sort that out.

- Stephen

notes.title: MASSIVE visual improvements. Suprise!
notes.content:
I've had it on my list for a while to update MusicWave's GUI and this was long overdue. The visuals are a lot more fun and informative!

Here's what's changed:

[list]
[*]Better placement of GUI meters
[*]New streak meter shows how close you are to each 50 increment.
[*]Animations and distinct colors for each meter so you can tell what it says without reading it.
[*]Multiplier meter now shows your streak progress
[*]Orbs are gold if you haven't missed a note
[*]FC indicator (Full combo (Having never missed a note or pressed something incorrectly))
[/list]

Let me know if you like the new visuals! Might even change a few more things before supporting custom skinning, I just want everything to be where it should be.

As for the control update bug:

I cannot recreate the bug you guys are talking about where you cannot rebind your controls. I added a reset to default button for if your controls got messed up you can reset them, but I still cannot recreate this bug.

Make sure you are clicking the rebind button and when it's red and says "??" you press the key you want to bind it to. I spoke to some people on the discord server and they said they weren't having issues either.

If you are having this issue please reach out to me, maybe take a video? I'd really like to sort it out.

Likely will only be one new song this Friday since it's my finals week.

That's all and as always, thanks for playing!

-Stephen

notes.title: Major Game Mechanic Change
notes.content:
I decided that MusicWave was too difficult and extremely unfriendly to beginners. There's really no need for a losing functionality anyways, that only makes players want to quit.

I want people to get practice while also getting score, practice mode felt like a waste of time. I decided to change the mechanics so people can get through the easy charts while getting better and having fun. Here are the two simple yet effective changes:

[list]
[*]No more losing.
[*]Missing a note or pressing the wrong key subtracts 30 points.
[/list]

This will score players better for being more accurate but allow people to make mistakes early on. I hope these changes make the game more fun and playable.

If you tried it and didn't like it, give the game another try! If you still don't like it, I appreciate that you gave it your time :)

-Stephen
